answers.core: It requires changes to the `RenderingServer` and also the reflection probe node class.
answers.workaround: It can, but at the moment it is very counter intuitive to do, and seems like it would be better to just update a probe manually than to change it's transform, also unrelated to the actual proposal since this is a bug, but I would like to still mention it since it relates to this issue, in some cases changing the transform doesn't even work like seen here: | | | | | ------------- | ------------- | ------------- | This is the code that changes the transform in the second image, which is also what is needed to update a reflection probe. ```gdscript extends ReflectionProbe var original_pos:Vector3 func _ready() -> void: original_pos = global_position func update_reflection_probe(): # To be called by signal global_transform.origin.y = original_pos.y + randf_range(-0.05,0.05) ```

title: Add a method to force a ReflectionProbe to update
